sources.name: IUPHAR/BPS Guide to PHARMACOLOGY
sources.admission_boundary: Interactions provide candidate action annotations only; every final label still requires a qualifying human functional assay and traceable primary publication.
sources.known_scale: The official human A2A pharmacology search reports 96 ligands before structure/scaffold/evidence exclusions.

sources.name: NCBI PubChem BioAssay
sources.admission_boundary: Exclude ChEMBL-mirrored assays, patents without a traceable qualifying primary publication, binding-only assays, and records lacking explicit agonist or antagonist direction.

sources.name: Versioned project wet-lab results
sources.admission_boundary: Assay protocol, plate-level quality control, blinded molecule identifiers, and signed human adjudication must be frozen before labels are joined.

explicitly_nonexternal_sources.reason: Visible to the project before v1.3 model and holdout analysis; permitted only for a retrospective external-like stress test.
Already accessed once and reported; immutable historical evidence.

multi_source_rule: No source is assumed to meet the 280-record target alone. Merge only after per-source snapshots, licenses, identifiers, evidence provenance, exact structures, and generic Murcko scaffolds are audited.
label_masking_rule: Discovery and structure screening operate on candidate files without functional_class, primary_binary_label, assay_readout, or evidence_rationale columns.
